experience.title: Software Engineer Intern, Co-op
bullets: Contributed on Sidekick, Shopify's AI commerce assistant, on the App-Gen platform team supporting AI app generation using Ruby on Rails backend and a reactive frontend powered by TypeScript, React, and Preact Signals.

Built a non-intrusive screenshot tool that captures and rasterizes Shopify web routes in offscreen sandboxed containers to generate cropped or full webp images of users’ apps, to provide Sidekick a visual understanding of app layouts.
Developed a UI Judge evaluation critic to score and assess AI-generated apps, against human-annotated benchmarks, to give live feedback and improve App-Gen agent performance in real time.

projects.title: Screendial
projects.subtitle: Native Desktop Copilot | Rust, TypeScript, Tauri v2
bullets: Developed an agentic desktop voice assistant that overlays directly on your screen to guide you through complex desktop or web software workflows with supporting tools and skills for different scenarios.
Used Tauri v2 and Rust to perform hardware-accelerated screen capture in <15ms, with TypeScript for on-screen interface.
Built a highlight tool that draws a bounding red box around specific UI elements on-screen such as buttons and menus, using normalized 2D coordinates, relative to the user's monitor resolution.
Implemented a tool that renders interactive UI cards over the screen, such as checklist steps, copyable code snippets, or info cards, to provide extra guidance along model results.

projects.title: Gemini Groceries & Recipe
projects.subtitle: React, Node.js, MongoDB, Gemini AI
bullets: Developed a full-stack grocery and recipe assistant using React.js, Node.js, Express.js, and MongoDB Atlas, enabling users to create smart shopping lists with AI for meal suggestions and nutrition tracking.

Integrated Google’s Gemini AI for image processing, to extract grocery items from shopping list photos and generate meal recommendations with nutritional facts and SerpAPI for product search and price matching between different grocery stores.
Implemented secure user authentication with JWT tokens, RESTful API design, and responsive UI using Tailwind CSS with interactive 3D components using Three.js.
Deployed on AWS Amplify with CI/CD pipeline using custom amplify.yml configuration.

projects.title: Patheon AI
projects.subtitle: Next.js, TS, ElevenLabs, Gemini
bullets: Built full-stack AI Physics research platform using Next.js, TypeScript, ElevenLabs and Google Gemini 2.0 Flash API, generating hypothesis-based analysis with citations, theories and experimental suggestions.
Implemented voice interaction with ElevenLabs integration, featuring voice cloning, speech-to-text transcription, and synchronized audio visualization for ease of accessibility.
Designed 3D space-themed UI with liquid glass effects, custom cursor animations, and responsive architecture using Tailwind CSS and Framer Motion.

projects.title: ASL Translation Software
projects.subtitle: Python, OpenCV, TensorFlow
bullets: Built and trained a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) for Computer Vision with TensorFlow, Keras API, and OpenCV to translate American Sign Language (ASL) characters, achieving 90.5% accuracy during translation.
Deployed model on a Python desktop app for demo during the cuHacking 2024 Hackathon, presenting how our software bridges communication gaps between deaf or non-verbal signers and non-signers.

projects.title: Ride Along
projects.subtitle: Flutter, Supabase
bullets: Led development of a cross-platform ridesharing mobile & web app for university students using Flutter and Supabase, enabling carpooling with peers and cutting 45% commute costs spent on other platforms.
Implemented in-app messaging and rendered live maps with driver and passenger location, using Flutter’s native geolocator dependency, ensuring stability across device platforms.
Designed Figma pitch deck and placed 2nd at cuHacking 2025 for community impact; deployed on AWS Amplify with CI/CD.
